backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the RBS backend, defining all shared types (UserProfile, FormSubmission, Poll, Alert, MarketIntelligence, etc.) and initializing state maps for users, submissions, polls, API keys, crypto currencies, and more, with mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs to their titles, affected source files, component dependencies, and test IDs for Market Intel, Market Pulse, Live Price, and other frontend features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted catalogue of short summaries for every frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, hook, page, and config file.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes covering colors, borders, charts, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'RBS Official V2.5 Institutional DeFi Hub' and mounting the React root via main.tsx.
frontend/NO_VISUAL_CHANGES_ALERTS_BACKEN: Documentation scoping a backend-only alerts system implementation, listing the new backend methods and React Query hooks added while explicitly prohibiting any visual/styling changes to frontend pages.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application file that configures TanStack Router with all page routes, wraps the app in QueryClientProvider and ThemeProvider, and composes the RootLayout with Header, Footer, BottomNav, AuthInitializer, and ScrollToTop.
frontend/src/components/AdminApiKeysPane: React component that displays and manages API key configuration for external data providers (CoinGecko, CryptoCompare, etc.), allowing admins to view key status and update keys via a form.
Non-visual component that triggers backend initialization once after authentication and invalidates React Query caches to load fresh data, handling expected errors like 'Already initialized' and 'Unauthorized'.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile (hidden on lg screens) with links to main app routes, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the RBS brand, Telegram and WhatsApp social links, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with logo, primary nav links, dropdown menus for Resources/Community/Analytics sections, and a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/PageHead.tsx: Non-visual component that imperatively sets the document title and meta description tag based on provided props.
frontend/src/components/ScrollToTop.tsx: Component that auto-scrolls to the top on route changes and renders a floating button to manually scroll to top when the user has scrolled past 500px.
frontend/src/components/SmokySectionTran: Wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to apply a visibility CSS class with an optional delay when the section enters the viewport, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/constants/redirectConfig.ts: Defines constant URLs and identifiers for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Binance Square social/redirect links, plus a helper function to return a mobile deep link or web URL for Binance Square.
frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts: Re-exports a flat SOCIAL_LINKS object mapping platform names to their URLs, sourced from redirectConfig.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, re-creating it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries on actor updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminConfig.ts: Provides React Query hooks for checking admin status, fetching API key statuses (currently mocked), and setting API keys via mutations.
Thin wrapper hook that checks whether the current user has Market Intel access and exposes the result with a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommunityVoting.ts: Aggregates poll-related queries and mutations into a single hook for creating polls, casting votes, and refreshing poll data, with helper utilities for vote calculations.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimer.ts: Fetches a presale or airdrop timer end time from the backend actor and drives a live countdown, returning formatted days/hours/minutes/seconds and an unlocked flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoNews.ts: Fetches the latest 20 crypto news items from the CryptoPanic public API, derives sentiment from vote counts, and caches results for 12 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity/status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePrice.ts: Polls the CoinGecko simple price API every 7 seconds to return live price, 24h change, market cap, and volume for a fixed list of five major cryptocurrencies.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketIntelLive.ts: Fetches 30-day OHLC data from CoinGecko for five coins, computes RSI, MACD, and MA crossover indicators, and derives BUY/SELL/HOLD signals with confidence scores.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketPulse.ts: Fetches Bitcoin's 30-day price history and current price from CoinGecko, computes RSI and MACD, and returns an overall Bullish/Bearish/Neutral market status refreshed every 20 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Provides two hooks: `useParallax` for scroll-based vertical offset and `usePointerParallax` for pointer-position-based offset, both respecting the `prefers-reduced-motion` media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend actor calls, covering user profile CRUD, market intel access, and alert management (fetch, create, mark-read, delete).
frontend/src/hooks/useRealWorldAnalytics: Fetches global crypto market data from the CoinGecko API and exposes it via a React Query hook, refreshing every 60 seconds, along with a `formatLargeNumber` utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useReliableAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity login/logout with race-condition prevention, a 30-second safety timeout, and automatic retry on 'already authenticated' errors, invalidating React Query cache on state changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useTokenAdvancedAnaly: Fetches 30-day price/volume data for a given token from CoinGecko and computes technical indicators (RSI, Bollinger Bands, volatility, volume trend, market strength) via a React Query hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Inter/Poppins fonts, configures Tailwind with CSS custom properties for a gold/dark theme, and defines ambient background animations with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapping the root `App` component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page for RBS that presents the company mission and a grid of six feature cards (security, speed, community, etc.) with parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/AcquisitionPage.tsx: Token acquisition page with tabbed Presale and Airdrop registration forms, each gated by a countdown timer; on unlock, form data is submitted via WhatsApp redirect, with pending submissions persisted in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/AdultFormPage.tsx: Age-verification form that collects personal details (name, DOB, country, email, phone, ID, purpose), validates the user is 18+, and submits the data by opening a pre-filled WhatsApp message.
frontend/src/pages/AdvancedAnalyticsPage: Token analytics page where users search by symbol to retrieve advanced metrics (Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, volume trend, risk level) via the `useTokenAdvancedAnalytics` hook, displayed in a grid of stat cards.
frontend/src/pages/AISentimentPage.tsx: Displays a list of crypto news articles fetched via the `useCryptoNews` hook, each tagged with a sentiment label (positive/negative/neutral) and a relative timestamp. Includes a 12-hour cache countdown timer and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AlertsCenterPage.tsx: A page for authenticated users to view, create, mark as read, delete, and toggle on-chain persistent alerts. Requires Internet Identity login and displays unread count with CRUD operations via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityGovernancePa: A static informational page describing RBS community governance, covering the proposal system, voting power mechanics, governance timeline, and participation statistics.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityHighlightsPa: A static page showcasing community achievements, featured members, initiatives, and stats such as total members and governance proposals for the RBS ecosystem.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityVotingPage.t: An interactive community polling page where users can join polls by code, cast votes, and create new polls (gated by a passcode). Uses a custom useCommunityVoting hook and Internet Identity for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: A contact page with a form that opens the user's email client via a mailto link, plus direct channel links to Telegram and WhatsApp.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperBlogPage.tsx: A placeholder developer blog page component with imports for cards, badges, and layout utilities but no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperToolsPage.ts: A placeholder developer tools page component with imports for cards, buttons, and icons but no implemented content.
frontend/src/pages/EcosystemGrowthPage.t: Displays the RBS ecosystem growth strategies page with four cards covering Community Expansion, Market Penetration, Product Development, and Value Creation, each showing key metrics. Uses parallax scrolling and smoky section transitions for visual effects.
frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.tsx: Renders a collapsible FAQ page with ten questions and answers covering RBS token details, governance, tokenomics, launch timeline, presale/airdrop participation, and security. Uses a stateful accordion-style UI to toggle individual FAQ items.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page featuring a hero section with the RBS logo, tagline, and navigation buttons to the acquisition and whitepaper pages. Also renders a grid of platform feature cards highlighting trading intelligence, analytics, and governance.
frontend/src/pages/IndicatorsGuidePage.t: Educational page explaining technical trading indicators (RSI, MACD, and others) using an accordion layout with descriptions, settings, and interpretation guidance. Styled with gold-themed glass cards and fade-in animations.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Real-time crypto market insights page that fetches and displays global metrics such as total market cap, BTC dominance, and other analytics via the useRealWorldAnalytics hook, refreshing every minute. Shows loading skeletons, error states, and timestamped data cards.
frontend/src/pages/LivePricePage.tsx: Displays real-time prices for the top 5 cryptocurrencies, refreshing every 7 seconds, with authentication guard requiring Internet Identity login to view.
frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: Passcode-gated page showing live trading signals and market intelligence, requiring both Internet Identity login and a valid passcode to unlock access.
frontend/src/pages/MarketPulsePage.tsx: Shows real-time Bitcoin market sentiment (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) with RSI, MACD, price, and 24h change indicators, auto-refreshing every 20 seconds.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 error page with navigation buttons to go home or back, plus quick links to key site sections like Tokenomics, Roadmap, Whitepaper, and Contact.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: Static page listing RBS ecosystem partners grouped into Strategic, Technology, and Community categories, each with partner names and roles.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Displays a timeline of RBS development phases from 2026 to 2028 with milestones, status badges (completed/in-progress/upcoming), and parallax scrolling effects.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityTransparencyP: Displays a security and transparency page for RBS with four feature cards (audits, multi-sig, transparency, reports) using parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/TestimonialsPage.tsx: Renders a testimonials page with a carousel of six community member quotes and a stats grid showing community size, token holders, security score, and satisfaction rate.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Shows RBS token distribution via a Recharts pie chart and lists utility features (staking, governance, fees, premium tools) with parallax and smoky section transitions.
frontend/src/pages/WhitepaperPage.tsx: Renders a multi-chapter whitepaper page with a sticky sidebar navigation that highlights the active chapter using IntersectionObserver and smooth scroll.
frontend/src/utils/timers.ts: Exports a single utility function that converts a nanosecond bigint duration into zero-padded days, hours, minutes, and seconds strings for countdown display.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Exports helpers to build, open, or redirect to a WhatsApp URL pre-filled with a formatted message using the configured direct number from REDIRECT_CONFIG.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch/hsl CSS variables), border radii, box shadows, keyframe animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (schema v1.0.0, version 3) describing a crypto dashboard with real-time market data features, listing existing implemented features, known issues (broken timers, forms), architectural notes, and a roadmap of planned fixes and enhancements.
